<header class="page-heading"><p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p><h1>Notice of Filing</h1><p>Use this short-form notice to identify supplemental material or another document submitted for the Court’s record.</p></header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> Identify exactly what is being filed and why it belongs in the record. Do not use a notice as a substitute for a motion when court action is requested.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>[CASE CAPTION]</h2><p>Case No. [DOCKET NUMBER]</p></div>
    <h2>NOTICE OF FILING</h2>
    <p><span class="template-placeholder">[PARTY]</span> gives notice of the filing of the following material in the above-captioned matter:</p>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Document / material</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Title or description]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Related filing</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[If applicable, identify related motion, order, or docket entry]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Purpose</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Briefly explain the purpose of the filing and any relevant procedural context.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Title / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
